name: What are the key components of an effective AEO strategy for a local contractor?

mainEntity.name: What are the key components of an effective AEO strategy for a local contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: An effective AEO strategy for a local contractor includes several key components. This involves ensuring your Google Business Profile is fully optimized with accurate, consistent information across all online directories. High-quality, localized content on your website that addresses common customer questions and showcases expertise is crucial. Generating and managing positive customer reviews, building relevant local citations, and establishing a strong backlink profile from authoritative local sources also contribute significantly to boosting your entity's visibility and trustworthiness in local search results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key AEO components for local contractors include Google Business Profile optimization, localized content, review management, local citations, and building relevant backlinks.
